Cruzer (by Crafter) browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events 2009 NAMM 2009 Cruzer (by Crafter) EF-OD Over Drive Published on January 21, 2009 Cruzer (by Crafter) overdrive pedal NAMM 2009 NAMM 2009 picture by Jesse Stern NAMM 2009 Information Crafter Housed in a rugged steel case and by the use of analogue circuitry with modern components, the Cruzer EF-OD Overdrive enables you to create classic valve overdrive tones with the rugged reliability and compactness made possible by today’s technology. True buffered bypass preserves the clean tone of your guitar and ensures silent switching between effect and bypassed signals.
